title: "JP, is everything alright ?"
description:
Devil, Devil, will this be your routine ?
Your wicked river, you shall burry.
The Devil, Devil, brought about ruin
From the piercing darkness, he sought to shatter.

0.1: Inevitably, we were bound to meet again.
0.2: We would like to present a Memento to you.
0.3: Shall you be able to read it through to the end?

1.jp1: #####, why did you bring me here?
1.v2: So you could meet my friend!
1.b3: Hey JP! I've heard a lot about you, apparently, we're gonna be thick as thieves!

2.b1: Just imagine that! The trip of a lifetime, from France to Australia!
2.v3: Can you believe it? That good old Bauk is quite the rascal!
2.jp4: #####, stop, cut it out, damn it, don't you think I see right through your game?!
2.v5: Easy, easy, what could I possibly have done to deserve such an outburst?
2.v6: We're just having a good time together, right?
2.jp7: OPEN YOUR EYES, ##### ! BAUK IS NOT AND WILL NEVER BE-
2.v8: Don't you even dare say his name.

3.v2: Hey ! Did you know that kang-
3.jp3: You've got to be kidding me! What exactly are you after?
3.jp4: I talk and talk and talk, I even started a conversation or two, and all for what?
3.jp5: We'll never get him back, it's over #####, just move on already.
3.v6: That's totally unrelated, I have no idea what you're talking about - whatever it was, it must have happened a loooong time ago.
3.jp7: Oh yeah? Totally forgotten, nothing left?
3.v8: Nothing, nada, finito! Onward to the future, let the past rest in peace!
3.jp9: Oh really? So what does the "S" in AVOS stand for?

4.b1: If I have a population of 2,300 different kangaroos in a given, isolated area, what's the probability that I'll find an opponent who's my equal?
4.jp3: No, I have no fucking idea, you stop that too!
4.jp5: Exactly! That! Do you think you're better than us?
4.jp6: I don't know how you can mimic him that well, you're definitely doing it on purpose, no way
4.jp7: You're too cheerful, too friendly, you're perfect, huh? Is that right?
4.jp8: You've gotta be a real LOWLIFE to make fun of him that way. He never asked to leave, he didn't have a choice.
4.b9: What on earth are you talking about?! It's probably just a huge misunderstanding, I can't see where you're going with this!
4.a10: Let's call it a night. I guess everyone has bad days, but that's no reason to take it out on others
4.a11: I'm locking the blog. Have a nice and peaceful night, kids, and tomorrow you'll go apologize

5.v1: Listen, I'm really sorry but I see what you were getting at...
5.jp2: Right, and what kind of line are you going to pull on me this time? That there's no resemblance between them?
5.v3: No, that's exactly it! I get it now, and that bothers me even more... Do you think he's doing it on purpose?
5.jp4: Are you shitting me? Of course he's doing it on purpose, after you've probably been showing him his whole life to make the resemblance stand out!
5.v5: Come on! I should be the one making those accusations!
5.jp6: So... neither of us filled him in? Who is it, exactly? A coincidence that big can't be real
5.v7: He came to me when the site first launched to sign up... Do you think he knew from the start?

6.b1: What a fight, huh? That guy didn't stand a chance against the upcoming winner of a once-in-a-lifetime fight!
6.jp2: Hahaha, yeah, he seemed happy to know he was up against a beginner until he saw you show up.
6.b4: Hey, JP, can I ask you something...? The other day, when you said some weird things about being Mister Perfect...
6.b5: I've been thinking about it a lot, and I'm sorry if it made you feel uncomfortable like that, I didn't mean to
6.b6: I know I love being the center of attention, I can't help it. Sometimes I get a little too carried away with it, it goes to my head, and I stop paying attention to what's going on around me.
6.b7: But then again, I'm getting a little carried away! I just have one question for you.
6.b8: JP, is everything alright? If you need someone to talk to, know that I'm here
6.s10: JP, sure you're okay, man? If you need me, I'm not going anywhere, always here to help!
6.m12: Is everything going well at home? Here, you can talk about it, no matter what they tell you back there.
6.13: Is everything going well at home?
6.d14: 'You trying to land me in DEEP SHIT? Is that it?
6.d15: Don't you think they already know? As if you needed to pile on ANOTHER LAYER of self-pity!
6.b16: JP ? Are you still with me?
6.d17: Next time you pull a stunt like that and start getting all sentimental, I swear...

7.jp1: Get lost, #####, I know what you wanted, I didn't do it
7.v2: Didn't do it? Didn't do what? You did go to Bauk's game, right?
7.jp3: Yeah, and I know what feelings you wanted that to bring out in me, it didn't work, and it never will!
7.jp4: I'd like to wish you all the best...
7.jp5: But I think, above all, I hope you find the help you need to get over his departure.

8.jp1: Go for it, the camera's rolling! It's finally time for you to do it!
8.jp2: I believe in you, Bauk, I know you've got this!

9.jpjr1: Dad, Dad, the school party, can we go, can we?!
9.jp4: Lemme just let Uncle Ed know, he told me he was waiting for the go-ahead so I could invite him!

10.1: You have reached the end of this Memento.
10.2: Its ending is different. You changed it by discovering a path known to none.
10.3: Was breaking the cycle, hypothetically, dependent on nothing more than this simple choice?
